delivery_methodology: The project will be executed using an AI-enabled agile approach characterized by short, time-boxed development cycles with regular demonstrations and continuous client feedback. This iterative process allows for incremental delivery of features and early validation of functionality.

AI tools assist by drafting code, documentation, and test cases, which are then reviewed, refined, and approved by the project team to ensure quality and alignment with client expectations. Scope changes are managed through controlled processes to maintain project focus and delivery timelines. This methodology promotes transparency, adaptability, and high-quality outcomes.
executive_summary: Kalinaw Trading Corporation seeks to implement a comprehensive Human Resource Information System (HRIS) to streamline employee data management, automate leave and attendance processes, and provide timely workforce insights. This initiative is critical to enhancing operational efficiency and supporting informed decision-making across all branches and departments.

Exist Software Labs proposes a tailored HRIS solution that integrates employee information management, time and attendance tracking, employee self-service, and management dashboards. The system will be delivered using an AI-enabled agile methodology, ensuring iterative development with continuous client feedback. Upon completion, Kalinaw Trading Corporation will have a unified, accurate, and accessible platform that supports HR operations and management reporting effectively.
proposed_solution: The proposed HRIS solution consolidates key HR functions into a single platform accessible to employees, HR staff, and management. It enables comprehensive employee record management, including personal data, employment movements, and document storage. Employees can self-service their profiles, leave applications, and view payslips, while HR staff manage leave policies, attendance logs, and organizational structure.

Management benefits from dashboards and reports that provide real-time insights into workforce metrics such as headcount, attrition, leave utilization, and overtime. The system also interfaces with the payroll system to ensure accurate data exchange for payroll processing. This integrated approach aligns with Kalinaw Trading Corporation’s operational workflows, enhancing data accuracy, process automation, and user accessibility.
technical_architecture: The HRIS is designed as a cloud-deployed microservices architecture leveraging Java and Spring Boot for backend services, React for the frontend interface, and PostgreSQL as the data store. This layered architecture separates presentation, business logic, and data management, facilitating scalability and maintainability.

Integration with external systems, such as payroll, is handled through secure APIs ensuring reliable data exchange and reconciliation. The system supports multiple environments for development, testing, and production, with robust security measures including role-based access control, audit trails, and encrypted data storage. This architecture meets the performance, availability, and security requirements specified by the client.
warranty_support: The solution includes a warranty period during which any defects or issues identified will be promptly addressed and corrected at no additional cost. Defects can be reported through a defined support channel, ensuring timely response and resolution.

The warranty covers software functionality as delivered but excludes issues arising from unauthorized modifications or external system changes. Post-warranty support and maintenance services are available as separate options to provide ongoing assistance and system enhancements beyond the initial warranty period.
